Mulching in the Blue Mountains

Fresh mulch supplied and spread across your garden beds — locking in moisture, feeding the soil, suppressing weeds and keeping everything looking sharp.

Mulch is the cheapest, most effective thing you can do for a Mountains garden. A good layer holds moisture through dry spells, insulates roots against frost, feeds the soil as it breaks down and keeps weeds down.

We supply and spread the right mulch for your garden — bark, woodchip, sugarcane or decorative — at the right depth, tidied up neatly around every bed and tree.

What’s included

  • Supply and spread quality mulch
  • Bark, woodchip and decorative options
  • Correct depth for moisture and weed control
  • Beds edged and tidied
  • Ideal before summer and frost
  • One-off or seasonal top-ups
